propositions: rebar search returns full ticket bodies including descriptions and comments, causing excessive output size (203 KB baseline) unsuitable for discovery operations
no --output flag support exists; rebar search --output json exits with code 2 treating the flag as unrecognized
no durable summary field exists in the schema; summaries must be derived from descriptions and truncated to 240 characters with whitespace normalization
search results must include case-preserving snippets containing the first matching term, bounded to 240 characters and sourced from any matching field (description, comments, tags, identifiers)
default search must return eight bounded fields (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) while --full preserves legacy full TicketState JSON
--output llm must emit newline-delimited minified JSON with short keys, null stripping, and incompatibility with --full flag
